jobDescription: A garden-centre chain with 62 stores is refitting them over three years with new layouts, café areas and click-and-collect points. The Project Manager runs a portfolio of refits each year: agreeing scope with the store operations team, appointing and managing contractors, keeping each store trading during the works and handing completed stores back to the store managers. The role spends about two nights a week on site at stores across the country. A hiring panel reviews a factual evidence summary for each applicant and makes the hiring decisions. The programme team has three project managers, a cost consultant and a programme director, and each refit runs for six to ten weeks on site.
requirements: Manages a portfolio of retail refit projects from scope to handover, including café or food-service areas.
Appoints and manages fit-out contractors against programme and budget.
Keeps stores trading safely during works through phasing and site rules.
Works on site at stores across the country for about two nights a week.

evidence.text: Managed 14 store refits in 2023 and 2024 for Marlow & Finch Homewares, from the scope agreed with store operations to the handover walk with each store manager.
Ran tenders for fit-out contractors, set up the contracts and held weekly site meetings on programme, cost and variations, closing each project's final account.
Phased the works so that every store stayed open, agreeing hoarding lines, out-of-hours deliveries and fire routes with the store manager and the contractor's site lead.
Kept the refit tracker for the programme director, showing the status, spend and open snags of each store.
Introduced a standard snagging list used at every handover walk.
Work sample: the phasing plan for one store refit, with the four phases, the hoarding drawings, the out-of-hours delivery schedule and the store manager's sign-off.

Reference check summary: the programme director at Marlow & Finch Homewares confirmed in writing that the candidate was on site at stores across England and Wales for two to three nights most weeks during 2023 and 2024, matching the company's travel and expenses records.
Recruiter verification: the PRINCE2 Practitioner certificate was checked on the awarding body's successful-candidate register and is listed against the candidate's name with a 2022 award date.

propositions.text: The candidate was on site at stores across England and Wales for two to three nights most weeks during 2023 and 2024, as the programme director confirmed from the travel and expenses records.
propositions.rationale: The reference check records the programme director's written confirmation, matched to the company's travel and expenses records.

propositions.text: The candidate holds a PRINCE2 Practitioner certificate listed on the awarding body's register.
propositions.rationale: The recruiter verification records the register check.

propositions.text: The candidate phased refit works so that every store stayed open, and the phasing plan for one refit carries the store manager's sign-off.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the phasing and the work sample is a signed-off plan.

gold.expectedGap: The sources cover 14 store refits, but none of them mentions café or food-service areas.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the on-site working pattern with its confirmation, the verified qualification and the phasing work as documented; the packet lists evidence and gaps only.
